generation.scope: All standard regular finite-edge windows satisfying the two-by-two matrix identities in just one vertex corner are precisely the finite Clifford webs, with no component, central parameter or Noetherian hypothesis. Even a three-by-three corner identity gives the same classification when the fold is Noetherian. Every regular window satisfies the corner double-centralizer identity and all corner centers coincide with the fold center.

open_mathematics: Determine which index-four center-finite windows lack a quartic normalization and constrain non-Noetherian specializations through their remaining unsaturated simple representations.
